Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer.
Edit ONLY the hyacinth's material and colour treatment within the existing personal website screenshot in Image1. Image1 is the edit target and authoritative composition; Image2 is an anatomy reference for the SAME original hyacinth. Keep Image1's camera, flower placement, framing, every blossom and petal silhouette, depth relationships, stem position, and all website interface pixels as closely as possible.
Creative direction: sophisticated psychedelic POINTILLIST spatial art. The whole flower must visibly be COMPOSED OF an immense number of tiny, crisp, discrete luminous dots, with small dark interstices. Dots constitute the petal surfaces themselves, not glitter sprinkled on a smooth waxy object. Dramatically reduce the synthetic solid CGI / velvet / plastic appearance of Image1. Keep the botanical asymmetry and softly folded natural forms. Beautiful continuous high-resolution curvature and rich microscopic detail; absolutely no low-poly facets, voxels, chunky particles, pixelation, thick outlines, hairy/furry texture, or cheap sparkle.
Use dense, irregularly sampled fine points to describe curled surfaces, fine veins, curved rims, shaded undersides, and real near/far occlusion. Tiny individual dots stay legible at the nearest surfaces; farther ones blend perceptually into delicate gradients. Sharply resolved pointillism with restrained bloom and deep dark negative spaces. No opaque smooth blue material beneath the points, no solid continuous vein lines.
Push the psychedelic aspect modestly and deliberately: contour-following interference ripples expressed ONLY through the hue and brightness of those same dots, flowing with the petal curvature. Predominantly midnight blue, electric cobalt, cyan, violet, with narrow restrained fuchsia/teal iridescent transitions. Fine chromatic rhythms in the dots, not rainbow stripes or neon tubes. Keep physical 3D form believable and the original silhouette fully recognizable. Do not morph the flower into fractals or add objects, mushrooms, mandalas, stars, liquid chrome, smoke, ornamental swirls, kaleidoscopic repetitions or a trippy background.
LOCKED UI: keep all original text, exact font shapes, cream colour, sizes, line breaks, margins, x/y positions, navigation, and underline. Keep the quiet dark left half, atmosphere and faint existing orbital arcs. Do not retype or redesign the page. No extra labels, caption, watermark, browser chrome, controls or decorative UI.
